name: 记忆闪卡
description: `.deck.md` 卡组文件 + FSRS 间隔重复复习台。卡片与复习进度全部存在本地笔记库(卡组 = 一等 .deck.md 文件,调度状态在文件 frontmatter 里,索引在插件工作文件夹,默认「记忆闪卡」);「从当前笔记生成卡组」会把当前笔记全文发送到你登录的 Forsion/Tangu 后端由 AI 出卡,除此之外数据不出本机。随包附带 flashcard-format 技能,让 Tangu 在聊天里也能直接建/改卡组而不破坏复习进度。
descriptionEn: `.deck.md` deck files plus an FSRS spaced-repetition review board. Cards and review progress live entirely in your local vault: a deck is a first-class .deck.md file, its schedule sits in the file frontmatter, and the index sits in the plugin work folder. "Generate deck from note" sends the full text of the current note to the Forsion/Tangu backend you are signed in to so the AI can draft cards; nothing else leaves your machine. The bundled flashcard-format skill teaches Tangu to create and edit decks in chat without breaking review progress.

onboarding.intro: 记忆闪卡把知识拆成问答卡片,用 FSRS 间隔重复安排每天该复习什么。卡组是笔记库里的 .deck.md 文件——可备份、可同步、可让 Tangu 直接读写。

steps.title: 建一组卡
steps.description: 文件树空白处或文件夹上右键「新建卡组」即建即开;卡组编辑视图里可就地改问题/答案、加卡删卡。手改内容不影响每张卡的复习进度。

steps.title: 让 AI 从笔记出卡
steps.description: 打开一篇笔记,命令面板运行「记忆闪卡:从当前笔记生成卡组」。生成进度显示在复习台顶部,可随时取消;生成的卡组落在插件工作文件夹(默认「记忆闪卡」)。

steps.title: 每天复习
steps.description: 命令面板「记忆闪卡:打开复习台」。空格/回车翻面,1-4 评分(重来/困难/记得/简单),FSRS 自动安排下次出现时间;每日新卡上限可在插件设置里调(默认 50)。

steps.title: 让 Tangu 也会写卡组
steps.description: 随包的 flashcard-format 技能教会了 Tangu .deck.md 的真实格式(card 标记 + fsrs 状态行)。在聊天里直接说「帮我把这篇笔记做成闪卡」也能得到规范的卡组文件——建好后在文件树里打开一次,它就会进入复习队列。

en.intro: Flashcards turns what you learn into question-and-answer cards and lets FSRS spaced repetition decide what to review each day. A deck is a .deck.md file in your vault, so it backs up, syncs, and can be read and written by Tangu directly.

steps.title: Make a deck
steps.description: Right-click empty space in the file tree, or a folder, and pick "New deck" — it opens as soon as it is created. The deck editor lets you rewrite questions and answers and add or delete cards in place. Editing the text never disturbs a card's review progress.

steps.title: Let the AI draft cards from a note
steps.description: Open a note and run "Flashcards: Generate deck from note" from the command palette. Progress shows at the top of the review board and can be cancelled at any time; the finished deck lands in the plugin work folder.

steps.title: Review every day
steps.description: Run "Flashcards: Open review board". Space or Enter flips the card, 1-4 grades it (Again / Hard / Good / Easy), and FSRS schedules when it comes back. The daily new-card limit is in the plugin settings (50 by default).

steps.title: Teach Tangu the deck format
steps.description: The bundled flashcard-format skill taught Tangu the real .deck.md format (card markers plus the fsrs state line). Asking it in chat to turn a note into flashcards produces a proper deck file — open it once in the file tree and it joins the review queue.
